narrative:

Your year-one standing was the next most influential factor, and it also pushed toward failure: you were again in the lowest decile, far below the accepted-student average near the sixth decile. Your undergraduate GPA was the third most important factor, but it worked in your favor: at 3.10, it is only slightly below the accepted average of 3.23, so it modestly pushed toward passing rather than failing.

The denial reflects the overall pattern, not one isolated number.
